notes.title: Real human voices have arrived in Andrew's Nightmare! 🎙️
notes.content:
Dear Community,

How have you been lately? Over the past few weeks, the team has been through a whirlwind of major changes and improvements that we’ll gradually be communicating. Now, we’re excited to announce that our development team has integrated [b]human voices recorded exclusively for Andrew's Nightmare.[/b]

[h2][b]Meet the Voices Behind the Characters:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Valentín Ángel Fernández[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963977/300329ad101f8e15bc588b787f979d7e9eb1944b.jpg[/img]

With extensive experience in voice acting and performance, Valentín is a talented actor who knows how to convey deep emotions and bring complex characters to life. His ability to capture the essence of Andrew makes him the perfect choice for the role. We’re confident that his portrayal will elevate the protagonist’s story to new heights, fulfilling our aspirations from the early design stages of the game.

[h3][b]George Ledoux[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963977/4a8cd3e50e465ef799b26d296ee1bb2e6b97cc3b.jpg[/img]

He will be the voice of the enigmatic [b]Dr. Braun.[/b] With an impressive catalog of work in the video game industry, George is widely recognized for his versatility and ability to bring a wide range of characters to life. His experience includes prominent roles in acclaimed titles where he has demonstrated his skill in creating unique and memorable characters. We couldn’t pass up the opportunity to have his talent bring our guide and professional, Dr. Braun, to life. We’re excited to see how his performance will add a new dimension to this intriguing character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963977/a6cc677eb0dd8822863add468100a678cecc67f1.jpg[/img][i](Valentín’s recording studio, where several of Andrew’s voices for the game were recorded)[/i]

[h3]Things are getting more and more interesting, and the team [b]is preparing to announce a very important news soon.[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/xuAGPAH2]Join our Discord community to stay updated[/url][/h3]
